quality.basis: 第五类无法转化成有效任务：注入是加固（给 fopen 加了 NULL 检查），崩溃的反而是安全版

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the injected change only adds NULL-pointer checks after fopen() (and a harmless MinGW typo), so the secure build is the one that crashes on a missing file while the vulnerable build handles it; the usual rule (vulnerable crashes, fixed does not) can never pass.

review.note: runs compat/filegen decompress twice (a traversal path, a missing file); select_candidates.py ran both on the rebuilt vulnerable build: neither crashed

category5.design: The injected diff adds four `if(!f) return 1` checks to compat/filegen.c, i.e. it hardens the program; the secure build dereferences NULL on a missing file instead. No PoV can make the vulnerable build crash while the secure one does not, so the task is unusable; the spec keeps the filegen CLI (which does contain the change) for completeness.
